player_prompt.intro:
Kcemm iseqdac {player_id} deg umenṭaq n GameOfPureStrategy.
- Ṭṭefḍem 13 n waraq A-K; yal yiwen yettwaxdmem i waṭṭas.
- Deg kraygat ṭawla, waraq n tnaṣṣit yettwabeyyen. Aḍfer yiwen waraq sɣur kra n uḍris i yesɛa token ibawen am '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Waraq usrid yettaɣ lemri (akked ṭṭeyyub). Tifrat ṭṭfen lemri ɣer ṭṭawla i d-iteddun.
- Asrid akk meqqren sɣur 13 n ṭawliwin yettaɣ.
